The post is in Hindi with the caption: "In Dono bhaiyo ne milke humein bohot loot rakha hai!" which translates to "The two brothers met and took a lot from us!" Below the caption, there is an image with a yellow background featuring a logo that resembles the Adidas and Puma logos. The text on the image reads: "The founders of Adidas and Puma are brothers."
